purpose: Adoption record for single-exp softmax normalization on the decode attention path

baseline.description: Merged oct attend scoring, value-pass unroll, FP32 j-unroll

candidate.description: attendSingleExp computes exp once per position, stores e = exp(score-max) in scores, normalizes by invSum, and keeps the eight/four/scalar score pairing plus the four-element value unroll. Decode path only (attentionRange); the train/prefill attend keeps the two-exp form.
candidate.exactness: NOT bit-identical: p = e*invSum differs from exp(s-lse) by up to ~1.9e-08 absolute (~0.9% relative on near-zero elements). lse remains bit-identical. Adopted under the completion-identical standard: every measured completion is byte-identical.

drift.completions_identical: 5 synthetic generation shapes x 24 trials + real Llama-3.2-3B 128-token runs, all byte-identical

limitations: Output values differ within ~2e-8; downstream argmax unchanged in all measurements, not a universal guarantee
